**Double click**
Detect Node (POST)
      ↓
Wait 5s
      ↓
Poll Node (GET urls.get)  ←──────────┐
      ↓                              │
IF {{ $json.status }} = "SUCCESS"    │
      │                              │
   FALSE ────────────────────────────┘ (loop back via Wait)
      │
   TRUE
      ↓
IF {{ $json.output.watermark }} = true
      ├── TRUE  → wmrMax/remove
      └── FALSE → skip, use original URL
